Privacy

SignVoice AI is a browser-based learning and isolated-sign recognition application. This page describes the application’s behavior; the hosting platform and external resource providers have their own policies.

Camera and recognition

Camera frames are processed on your device by the bundled hand-tracking model. The application does not send your camera feed to its server. Recorded training examples contain hand landmarks and your labels, not webcam video.

What this browser saves

Settings, language choice, bookmarks, practiced markers and learning notes are saved locally. Personal sign examples, imported reference entries and permission-confirmed lesson videos and images use browser storage. Conversation history is saved only if you turn that option on. Anyone with access to this browser profile may see saved material.

External videos and speech

Opening a resource link takes you to another site. Embedded source demonstrations load only when you press Play or Watch sequence, and the provider receives your normal connection information. Browser and system speech voices may send text to a speech service; voice availability and privacy depend on your device.

Offline storage

Offline mode is optional. It caches public app assets on this device. Camera assets and local catalogs are cached after their first use online. External video providers are not cached.

Control and deletion

Export recordings and learning progress before deleting data. Remove individual personal clips in World languages. Voice & settings → Delete recordings, references and history removes recordings, imported references, clips, progress and history. Remove offline cache separately. Original source files are your video/image backups; progress exports do not include video bytes.

Hosting

The application has no accounts, analytics, advertising or application database. Your hosting provider may retain access logs or require sign-in. This deployment’s operator manages sharing and hosting separately.

Signing studio practice

Saved sourced motion packs, review attribution, practice phrases and review counts stay in this browser’s local storage. They are not uploaded or synced to an account. You can remove a saved phrase using its × button, or clear motions, phrases and counts with Delete all local data in Settings. The textured 3D model downloads from this app’s own server and can be cached for offline use.
